email.subject: your oct 22 filing
email.body:
Hi Sherzod,

Your federal liability filing shows an end date of October 22 on the CorePointe Insurance policy. Is that still in motion?

Corgi is a licensed insurance carrier writing auto liability and cargo for fleets directly, with no broker in between. If you want a second number before October 22, we can quote it this week.

Worth a look?

[Your name]

messages.followup:

[Your name]
messages.linkedin_note: Hi Sherzod, [Your name] at Corgi, a trucking insurance carrier. Your federal filing shows a liability end date of October 22. If the replacement isn't settled, happy to quote before then.
messages.linkedin_dm: Hi Sherzod, your federal liability filing shows an end date of October 22 with CorePointe Insurance. We are a carrier writing auto liability and cargo for fleets directly. If the replacement isn't settled, want a quote before then?
messages.why: Leads with the date from the public federal filing (S2), names where it was seen, and never says why the policy is ending. No proof line: Corgi has published no trucking customer or speed claim.

notes: A replacement policy can be filed any day. Re-run this account on the day you reach out.
The filings never say why a policy is ending. Do not state or imply a reason.
